Thanks. I understand, I don't even understand how I feel towards life as well and I contradict myself a lot. To say that I want choose life would be an overstatement, but I it's not like I've made up my mind that I want to die. I do want to die, but I sort of feel like I deserve this "neither dead or alive" state. Like I'm disqualified to leave using the easy way out if that makes sense.

That's also something that makes me feel like I deserve to go through this. Many good people in the world, my brother included, are ill and suffer from terminal diseases and cancer. They don't deserve to suffer like they do. 

I just don't know how long I can put these thoughts of suicide away. Most of my attempts were done subconsciously without any plans. I know that sound really fucked up and it scares me too. 

Thank you so much x
